description: This file implements cache backend creation and management for disk cache, including classes for cache creation, cleanup, and file operations, with platform-specific handling and testing utilities.

classes.name: CacheCreator
classes.description: Handles creation and initialization of disk cache backends with platform-specific logic and cleanup handling.

classes.name: TrivialFileEnumerator
classes.description: Implements file enumeration for trivial file operations.

classes.name: UnboundTrivialFileOperations
classes.description: Provides a method to bind trivial file operations.

methods.name: CacheCreator::Run
methods.description: Starts cache creation process, choosing backend type based on platform and configuration.

methods.name: CacheCreator::TryCreateCleanupTrackerAndRun
methods.description: Attempts to create a cleanup tracker before running cache creation.

methods.name: CacheCreator::DoCallback
methods.description: Invokes the callback with the creation result.

methods.name: CacheCreator::OnIOComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of I/O operations during cache creation.

methods.name: CacheCreator::OnCacheCleanupComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of cache directory cleanup and retries creation if successful.

methods.name: TrivialFileOperations::CreateDirectory
methods.description: Creates a directory at the specified path.

methods.name: TrivialFileOperations::DirectoryExists
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists at the specified path.

methods.name: TrivialFileOperations::OpenFile
methods.description: Opens a file with specified flags.

methods.name: TrivialFileOperations::DeleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a file, with optional immediate availability enforcement.

methods.name: TrivialFileOperations::EnumerateFiles
methods.description: Returns an enumerator for files in a directory.
